title: Factor the local inverse at the normal-section invariant
statement: For a normalized diagonal chart C, define twistToNormal as the target-open Tate comparison followed by inverse beta. Define normalToDualizing for any affine diagonal geometry H as inverse delta followed by alpha, inverse rho and the coefficient-unit comparison. Then localInverse(C)=twistToNormal(C) followed by normalToDualizing(C.geometry), as an equality of isomorphisms. These are actual compositions of the existing canonical isomorphisms.

theorem localInverse_factors (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f] [HasCompactification f]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (V : Y.affineOpens) (C : OrientationRefinement.Chart P f aY d V) :
    OrientationCounit.localInverse P d f aY V C =
      twistToNormal P d f aY V C ≪≫ normalToDualizing P d f aY V C.geometry
